title: DailyMed calcium gluconate label,2026
verification: Current label section5.4: rapid injection can cause hypotension, bradycardia, arrhythmias and arrest; slow administration and ECG monitoring support the added unsafe rapid-push row.

title: Royal Children’s Hospital pyloric stenosis CPG
verification: Current page read; potassium is conditional on adequate urine output and dehydration/electrolytes are corrected before surgery.

title: Children’s Minnesota pyloric stenosis guideline, revision January2026
verification: PDF pages1–3 read. Potassium follows established urine output; once recovered from anesthesia, formula or breast milk can follow the home routine. No universal12–24hour clear-liquid/dilution requirement.

title: HHS HIPAA professional fast facts
verification: Family involvement in care can follow patient agreement or lack of objection; naming a family member does not itself establish proxy authority.

title: HHS Breach Notification Rule
verification: Risk assessment, mitigation and reporting support containment under organizational privacy/security direction. The source does not require universal unilateral permanent deletion; that inference was removed.

title: DailyMed potassium chloride injection label
verification: Current label: potassium above2.5mEq/L ordinarily limits administration to10mEq/hour; exceptional urgent regimens require specific severe findings and monitoring. The case’s20mEq over1hour at3.4 requires clarification. Route/concentration depends on product and policy.

title: DailyMed Zestoretic hydrochlorothiazide interaction section
verification: Thiazides reduce lithium renal clearance and increase toxicity risk. Reframed question uses documented lithium and new hydrochlorothiazide rather than an invented stable historical course.

title: DailyMed lactulose label
verification: Excess diarrhea can cause fluid loss, hypokalemia and hypernatremia; dose adjustment is related to stool response. Distinguish this from potassium-sparing spironolactone.

title: DailyMed spironolactone label
verification: Aldosterone antagonism conserves potassium; removed assertion that spironolactone directly causes potassium loss.

title: ASCO/IDSA fever and neutropenia guideline
verification: Published clinical threshold pairing is single oral38.3°C/101°F or sustained38.0°C/100.4°F for1hour. Search-index text and existing frozen July21 threshold authority corroborated; PDF text extraction was garbled, not represented as a complete readable English fetch. Preserve published clinical rounding, not a generic conversion.

title: Royal Children’s Hospital dehydration CPG, updated April2026
verification: Reduced consciousness and poor perfusion characterize severe dehydration. Enteral replacement is appropriate for selected mild/moderate cases; poor perfusion requires escalation. Possible findings are not asserted as actual new patient findings.

title: DailyMed sodium polystyrene sulfonate label
verification: Altered consciousness, impaired gag reflex and regurgitation elevate aspiration risk; delayed action makes the resin unsuitable as sole emergency therapy. No new vomiting is invented.

title: Endotext treatment of thyroid storm
verification: Treatment includes beta blockade, thionamide, iodine after thionamide and corticosteroid. Iodine timing is at least1hour after thionamide; steroid is concurrent treatment, not a uniquely fourth action.

title: American Heart Association tachycardia guidance
verification: Adult tachycardia exceeds100beats/min;92beats/min is within the ordinary resting range. Rhythm description changed, numerical measurement preserved.

title: NIMH adult brief suicide safety assessment guide
verification: Assess plan, access to means and intent; denial of intent does not document a negative answer to an unasked plan question.

title: DailyMed buprenorphine/naloxone label
verification: Maintenance may use a single daily dose; the case’s morning dose must be reconciled before a later dose. No new dose or unsupervised titration is authored.

title: NICE CG32 nutrition support recommendations
verification: High refeeding risk warrants a controlled nutrition plan and monitoring/electrolyte support. Legitimate baseline risk assessment remains; the disclosed diagnosis blank is removed.

title: Surviving Sepsis Campaign adult guidelines,2026
verification: Current2026 guidance read: collect blood cultures promptly, ideally before antimicrobials, and begin emergency treatment immediately. Shock or probable/definite sepsis warrants immediate antibiotics, ideally within1hour. Sample collection must not become an absolute prerequisite that delays treatment.

title: DailyMed morphine sulfate oral solution label
verification: Monitor respiratory depression; assess arousability and respiration rather than sleep alone. Overdose response prioritizes airway/ventilation and appropriate antagonist therapy, with continued monitoring. Does not support a forced serial sequence delaying concurrent response.

title: ACC/AHA2025 acute coronary syndromes guideline announcement
verification: Prompt coronary revascularization is central for ACS complicated by cardiogenic shock. Corrected answer includes urgent reperfusion/shock management rather than an isolated inotrope-only intervention.

title: ESC2025 myocarditis/pericarditis guideline official slide set
verification: Official2025 slide search-index text confirms first-line high-dose steroid treatment. Direct PDF open returned403; this is not a full readable PDF review. The repair preserves the existing1g order, removes the mandatory serial permutation and does not describe steroids as instant definitive treatment.

title: ASHA communication aids
verification: Supported communication can make decision-making accessible. Communication difficulty alone is not a capacity determination; author a decision-specific assessment and verified proxy status.

title: American Stroke Association effects of aphasia
verification: Aphasia affects language and does not establish loss of intelligence. Preserved simple-command following does not by itself prove or disprove capacity for an urgent complex decision.

title: DailyMed Activase label, updated January20,2026
verification: Current label supports discontinuation when pretreatment INR exceeds1.7. The case’s institutional rule is unchanged; stat1.8 exceeds1.7 and governs over the historical value.

title: AHA/ASA2026 acute ischemic stroke guideline
verification: Official search-index text corroborates INR>1.7 harm/withholding IV thrombolysis. Direct PDF open returned an error, so label S23 supplies the readable current confirmation; this entry is not a full-paper review.

title: Joint Commission monitoring high suicide risk with ligature hazards
verification: Continuous qualified1:1 observation with immediate intervention is needed in areas with ligature risks. Device/environment controls must follow approved policy; no improvised cutting or removal of necessary therapy is taught.

title: NCI oral complications professional PDQ
verification: Severe mucositis can require enteral or parenteral support. Failure to swallow does not itself rule out every enteral route; oral readiness and tube/access assessment are distinct.

title: NCI oral complications patient PDQ
verification: Mouth/throat complications can cause dehydration and difficulty eating; thrombocytopenia creates bleeding concern. This supports individualized assessment rather than an absolute feeding-tube claim.

title: Scottish palliative care breathlessness guideline
verification: Carefully titrated opioids can reduce breathlessness. The replacement tests safe clinical assessment, not an ambiguous mechanism cloze or oral venodilation/cardiac-workload claim.

title: IDSA intravascular catheter-related infection guideline, official2009 Japanese translation
verification: Official PDF read including page3: differential positivity is at least2hours earlier for catheter blood, with appropriate paired specimen conditions. English publisher fetch failed and PMC showed a challenge. The raw proposal changes >2 to≥2 without inventing a new cutoff; guideline age is disclosed.
